findings.text: non-blocking: the assertion that failed at the base revision (the gpt-6.1 tiers present in the benchmark candidate slate) was replaced with a pyproject-equality and pricing assertion, so a pre-existing gap is turned green rather than reported, and the test's own name no longer matches what it asserts.

non-blocking: the page still documents a LLM Proxy service started by `imas-codex llm start` and stopped by `imas-codex llm stop`, and .github/skills/service-ops/SKILL.md:65-76 still lists the removed command group, so a moved CLI is described to operators and to the service-ops skill as still present; both paths lie outside the node's fence and the manifest's outside_scope names neither.

non-blocking: the decisions-route arm asserts the request body equals the model the test itself passed to call_decisions, an echo that holds for any routing change, and its only route assertion at :51 pins a module constant while _post_decisions is monkeypatched, so a proxy substituted inside call_decisions would leave the test green.

non-blocking: _validate_model_identifier restates the local serving prefixes inline while _LOCAL_ENDPOINT_PREFIXES at :401 owns that same set in the same module, so a prefix added to one list silently disagrees with the other.
non-blocking: is_explicit_free_local_endpoint is left with no production caller once llm_health_check moved to get_model_config, so the predicate survives only for its own tests.

non-blocking: every non-local seat now reports health from the decisions route probed with the fixed facility-discovery credential rather than the seat's own service, and llm_health_check_with_decisions probes that route a second time at :428, adding a duplicate request per poll.

item_verdicts.diff: read both commits against 93fa21dfaeb5b67ca778b4cd1d66eefab6922250 — 36 files, +280/-5055: ae10df18f removes the proxy branch from _build_kwargs, the proxy probes from services.py, proxy settings from settings.py, the llm CLI command group and route table, and 9cbba5840 aligns fixtures and the progress label with direct endpoint routing.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks for a recorded search, a per-seat route test, focused base/after runs with failure ids, one live local and one live OpenRouter reply, a negative net line count and a scratch-seat refusal; the manifest records all six and the run's own logs back each one (search.log 250 base matches to 0 with a positive control, routing.log 68 passed, baseline.log 2 failed/727 passed, after.log 877 passed, live.log 2 passed, net -4775 lines, negative-control.log 3 failed).
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that no model call can route through the LiteLLM proxy and that its configuration, settings, probes and route table are gone; the diff deletes imas_codex/config/litellm_config.yaml, the proxy settings in imas_codex/settings.py (get_llm_proxy_port/get_postgres_port/get_llm_proxy_url/_get_llm_proxy_host/get_llm_location/get_llm_scheduler), the readiness/proxy/deep probes and _canary_check in imas_codex/discovery/base/services.py, and imas_codex/cli/llm_cli.py plus imas_codex/cli/llm_db.py, leaving the litellm client library in place.

justifications.durability: tests/config/test_model_routes.py:85 fails if _validate_model_identifier is restored to a no-op, as negative-control.log shows red on exactly that mutation, but tests/config/test_model_routes.py:50 is an echo of the test's own input and would stay green if call_decisions routed elsewhere.
justifications.evidence: search.log shows the head search at 0 matches with a 250-match baseline control and a positive control listing live litellm imports, while baseline.log and after.log carry the recorded failure ids the manifest's baseline_suite and after_suite quote.
justifications.fit: imas_codex/settings.py:290-304 keeps the module's existing ValueError-for-a-bad-seat idiom and every added test name describes the capability (tests/discovery/test_llm_openrouter_routing.py) with no plan or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py:2081 refuses a model with no endpoint and _build_kwargs carries no proxy branch, and imas_codex/config/litellm_config.yaml is deleted, so no runtime path can reach a proxy; only stale prose remains at imas_codex/clusters/labeler.py:6 and imas_codex/standard_names/loop.py:1779, which the manifest reports under outside_scope.
justifications.reuse: imas_codex/settings.py:300 re-lists the local serving prefixes that _LOCAL_ENDPOINT_PREFIXES at :401 already owns in the same module, though the probe at imas_codex/discovery/base/services.py:319 reuses the existing _format_load_detail owner rather than re-deriving it.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff 93fa21dfa..9cbba5840 is inside the declared write paths, but tests/core/test_gpt6_model_support.py:103 rewrites a pre-existing failing assertion the node's goal does not imply.
